title: Brand-checked-timers pin exercises only the set seam — a detached clearTimeout regression would pass every test
detail: The r2-B1 fix wrapped BOTH timer refs, but the brand-check test triggers once, so trigger()'s `if (id !== null)` skips t.clear. Reverting `clear` to a detached `env.clearTimeout` passes all 98 tests yet throws Illegal invocation in real browsers on a second step-change within 800ms. The pending save still fires, so impact is degraded, not fatal.
recommended_fix: In the brand-checked test, fire EVENT_STEP_CHANGED twice without runAll() between, forcing t.clear with a pending id through the brand-checked clearTimeout wrapper.
